```yaml
name: Nuitka Linux

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: '3.11'

jobs:
  build-linux:
    name: Build Linux AMD64 (${{ matrix.variant.name }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        variant:
          - name: threaded
            async: "False"
          - name: async
            async: "True"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install nuitka==2.4.5

      - name: Set default async mode
        run: |
          sed -i "s/^async = .*/async = ${{ matrix.variant.async }}/" config.ini

      - name: Build Linux binary with Nuitka
        run: |
          python -m nuitka \
            --onefile \
            --output-dir=dist \
            --include-package=lib \
            --include-data-dir=db=db \
            --include-data-file=config.ini=config.ini \
            --include-data-dir=lib/report=lib/report \
            --enable-plugin=numpy \
            --enable-plugin=qt5 \
            --enable-plugin=pylint-warnings \
            --remove-output \
            dirsearch.py

      - name: Handle Nuitka output name differences
        run: |
          # Nuitka on Linux produces binaries without extension
          if [ -f "dist/dirsearch" ]; then
            mv "dist/dirsearch" "dist/dirsearch-linux-amd64-${{ matrix.variant.name }}"
          fi

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dirsearch-linux-amd64-${{ matrix.variant.name }}
          path: dist/dirsearch-linux-amd64-${{ matrix.variant.name }}
          retention-days: 30
```
